from collections import Counter
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    px=[(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg]
    strip_rows=[0,h-1]
    # strips: (row, cols set)
    strips={r:{c for rr,c,v in px if rr==r} for r in strip_rows}
    seeds=[(r,c,v) for r,c,v in px if r not in strip_rows]
    scol=seeds[0][2]
    (t,ts),(b,bs_)= (0,strips[0]),(h-1,strips[h-1])
    off = (min(bs_)-min(ts)) if ts and bs_ else 0  # bottom_start - top_start
    # translated seeds -> full columns
    for r,c,v in seeds:
        cc=c+off
        if 0<=cc<w:
            for rr in range(h): out[rr][cc]=scol
    # real seeds: fill toward strip containing their column
    for r,c,v in seeds:
        if c in ts:   # top strip column -> fill up
            for rr in range(0,r): out[rr][c]=scol
        elif c in bs_: # bottom strip column -> fill down
            for rr in range(r+1,h): out[rr][c]=scol
    # seeds -> 4
    for r,c,v in seeds: out[r][c]=4
    # redraw strips
    for r in strip_rows:
        for c in strips[r]: out[r][c]=g[r][c]
    return out
